title: Handoff mailboxes per workflow
action: Handoffs move to .bee/runtime/handoffs/<workflow-id>/<seq>.json {id, workflow_id, from_session, target_role, previous_cell, next_cell, claim_epoch, kind, status}. state handoff write/show/adopt route per-workflow (bound session resolves its workflow; --lane names it). Adopt = transfer claim (epoch-checked per msn-12) then idempotent clear. Legacy .bee/HANDOFF.json becomes a projection of the newest open handoff (rebuilt by state-projection) until retirement in slice 5. One workflow pausing never blocks another (invariant 9 test); reviewer handoff never clobbers implementer handoff (distinct seq records, test). Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed). Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/ (vendored to .bee/bin/ + plugin mirrors).

truths: workflow A paused, workflow B starts and adopts freely (test, invariant 9)
two handoffs for one workflow keep distinct seq, adopt takes newest open (test)
legacy HANDOFF.json projection stays consistent for old readers
prohibitions: no handoff write outside the mailbox except the projection

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check
